pricing.title: Start validating before you start spending
pricing.subtitle: Explore the tools you need to make smarter business decisions.

items.q: Can I search for any business?
items.a: Yes. Enter any business idea or category. BusinessAI evaluates it using your budget, location, experience and interest, then surfaces matching opportunities.

items.q: How does the Government Subsidy check work?
items.a: We automatically map your project capex, industry type, and applicant category to national schemes like PMEGP (15% to 35% capital grant), MUDRA loans, and CGTMSE collateral guarantees.

items.q: Can I export the report for bank loan approval?
items.a: Yes! The Pro and Business tiers allow you to export official bank-ready Project Appraisal Dossiers in formatted PDF format ready for submission to SBI, HDFC, PNB, and cooperative banks.

items.q: Which cities and towns are covered in India?
items.a: Our AI platform indexes tier-1 metros (Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Pune) as well as 600+ tier-2 and tier-3 towns across India.

items.q: How accurate are the financial estimates?
items.a: Financial figures are estimates to aid initial decision-making. Always validate assumptions with current local costs and professional advice before investing.
No. No tool can guarantee profit. BusinessAI provides estimates, comparisons, and risk signals to help you make a more informed decision.
